overviewParagraphs: Aquella Golf Resort & Country Club represents Phuket's most modern premium golf offering — a meticulously crafted coastal facility featuring platinum paspalum turf throughout the course, a playing surface prized in tropical golf for its salt tolerance, visual vibrancy, and superior playability in humid conditions. The result is fairways and greens that look and play immaculately regardless of Phuket's seasonal weather.

The course design takes full advantage of its coastal positioning — multiple holes play off elevated tees with Andaman Sea panoramas, and the routing thread between the island's hillside and coastal terrain creates a pleasing variety of hole shapes and challenge levels. It is a course that rewards both experienced tournament golfers and resort visitors approaching the game more casually.

AGS recommends Aquella for clients who want a premium but comfortable Phuket round alongside the dramatic experiences of Red Mountain and Blue Canyon. Its modern facilities and excellent service standards make it a natural fit for any high-end Phuket golf program.

curatorBriefHtml: Aquella Golf & Country Club is a premier Par 72 championship layout in Phang Nga, Thailand, crafted by Pacific Coast Design (2021) and stretching to 6,532 Yards (Blue Tees) across a coastal, andaman sea views environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its direct andaman beachfront frontage (Signature ocean par-3) and platinum te paspalum carpet roll (Firm, bouncy links turf).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Aquella Golf & Country Club (Resort & Visitor Access via AGS) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Thailand dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its caddie coastal wind mastery (Navigates sea breezes), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Phang Nga golf tour by AGS, Aquella Golf & Country Club provides a distinct architectural test by Pacific Coast Design that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.

scorecard.verdict: Phang Nga's premier coastal links facility. Located on the pristine sands of Thai Muang Beach, Aquella features firm, bouncy turf, authentic sea breezes, and an exquisite beachfront signature par-3.

faqs.q: What are the key course specifications for Aquella Golf & Country Club?
faqs.a: Aquella Golf & Country Club in Phang Nga, Thailand is a Par 72 championship layout designed by Pacific Coast Design (opened 2021), measuring 6,532 Yards (Blue Tees) within a coastal, andaman sea views setting. It is particularly noted for direct andaman beachfront frontage (Signature ocean par-3).

Asia Golf Specialists secures guaranteed morning tee times, compulsory caddie and cart pairings (caddie coastal wind mastery (Navigates sea breezes)), and private VIP transfers from your Phang Nga hotel as part of a custom golf itinerary.

faqs.q: What playing conditions and turf can golfers expect at Aquella Golf & Country Club?
faqs.a: Our field inspection highlights Aquella Golf & Country Club's platinum te paspalum carpet roll (Firm, bouncy links turf) alongside direct andaman beachfront frontage (Signature ocean par-3). Standard championship golf attire (collared shirts, tailored trousers or shorts, and soft-spike golf shoes) is strictly enforced by the starter.
